query.text: 生活助手，请帮我留意家里的水电，如果有没关的情况请提醒我。
query.text_en: Life assistant, please help me keep an eye on the water and electricity at home, and remind me if anything is left turned on.

annotation.text_zh: 水龙头还没关，记得关一下。
annotation.text_en: The tap is still running, please remember to turn it off.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
